text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#98765 - GPU memory pressure on cluster infer-pool-us-west2a (severity: high)

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty -> page fired to #oncall-sre (primary: Ryan)

Ana (SRE): acked. jumping in. seeing OOMs across a few pods.

Marc (runtime): copying logs: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` repeated, kv-cache evictions spiking. stack snippet: 
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/serve.py", line 412, in _step
    out = model.forward(inputs)
RuntimeError: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: out of memory
```

Ana (SRE): `nvidia-smi` on node gpu-42 shows: 
```
GPU 0  Tesla-A100  40960MiB / 40960MiB  (100%)
Processes: python[pid 11234], python[pid 11235]
```

Ryan (oncall): oncall-ack. patching autoscaler to add +2 GPUs to infer-pool, and routing low-priority traffic to cpu-fallback for now.

Marc (runtime): pushing a quick config to reduce `max_batch_tokens` from 2048 -> 1024 for the real-time model groups (will reduce throughput but cut mem pressure). applying now.

Infra-AutoScaler: autoscale request accepted: scaling infer-pool-us-west2a by 2 nodes (expected ready ~ 90s).

Ana (SRE): starting targeted evacuation for node gpu-43 (preemptive) — cordon + drain low-priority pods: `kubectl cordon gpu-43 && kubectl drain gpu-43 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector=tenant!=enterprise`

Marc (runtime): note: we're seeing a correlated spike from multi-tenant batch jobs hitting prefix cache. Rolling back a recent prefetch flag that was enabled at 08:12.

Joel (CS): receiving customer reports: two mid-market customers reported increased latencies and 5xxs, sending status update to affected customers now. No paid-enterprise customers impacted yet.

Ana (SRE): quick mitigation checklist: 
- scale +2 (in progress)
- reduce batch token size (done)
- cordon+drain gpu-43 (started)
- disable aggressive prefetch (in progress)
- enable fallback routing to quantized-model (manual)

Marc (runtime): routing change applied: 8% of traffic shifted to quantized-llama-q4 for best-effort requests. Monitoring quality/regressions.

Ryan (oncall): if we don't see memory usage fall below 85% within 3min after scale/drain, we'll escalate to PD level-2 and trigger multi-region failover.

incident-bot: automation note: escalation timer started (3m). If unacknowledged/escalated, PD autopage will target SRE+ENG leads.

Ana (SRE): quick `kubectl logs` from pod infer-abc-12: `KVCache: eviction_count=1989, kv_cache_mem=38.6GiB, alloc_failures=3` — looks like the cache growth + a large batched request caused transient OOMs.

Marc (runtime): pushing hotfix: cap kv-cache to 28GiB per-pod and enable per-tenant cache quotas. patch id: runtime-hotfix/2026-03-17-01. rolling to canary (2 pods) now.

Infra-AutoScaler: new nodes joined: gpu-44 and gpu-45 in us-west2a. Scheduling redistributed.

Ana (SRE): memory usage trending down. `nvidia-smi` now: GPU0 67%, GPU1 63%. Evictions dropping.

Joel (CS): sent interim update to customers: "We're mitigating a GPU memory pressure event affecting inference throughput; mitigation in progress, traffic being routed to fallback models, ETA for stabilization ~10-15 minutes."

Ryan (oncall): good. keep monitoring for error spikes. I'll stay on hand for handoff if paging continues.

Marc (runtime): can everyone drop any persistent logs or interesting traces to #eng-runtime for postmortem? I'll collect KV eviction samples and the timeline.

Ana (SRE): will follow up with a short incident note in 30m. If stable, we can close PD within 45m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD#98765 acknowledged by Ryan at root message. current status: mitigation in progress, severity: high -> stabilizing.

Ryan (oncall): marking for handoff at 1748130300 — if stable at that time I'll hand off to day SRE rotation for follow-up.

Joel (CS): flagged affected customer list for post-incident review.

Marc (runtime): quick ops note for postmortem: look at prefetch flag flip at 08:12, multi-tenant batch window at 08:15, kv-cache caps not enforced for tenants > X.

Ana (SRE): thanks team. :thumbsup:
